_about: Public-domain Stopford Augustus Brooke (1832-1916), Anglican and later Unitarian minister of Bedford Chapel, London, for the Word Hoard: his books of sermons from St. James's Chapel and Bedford Chapel (1869-1919), Freedom in the Church of England (1871), Theology in the English Poets (1874), The Old Testament and Modern Life (1896), and his Life and Letters of F. W. Robertson (1865). His literary books are left to the literature shelves. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 75 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
